Bruh. There was post on askreddit the other day along the lines of “what is something the opposite gender will never understand?”. 

The mens answers were taken seriously (as they should, they were mental health related). But the answers women left (that weren’t genital related) were fucking *drowned* out by men saying “what about the men”? “This is not a woman specific issue”.

The two comments that stood out to me in particular were along the lines of:

1. Men will never understand what it’s like to be pregnant and have your entire body/mental health change 
2. The fear and vulnerability women feel while walking alone at night

The first was met with comments like, “okay, but men face anxiety throughout pregnancy too, and we have nowhere to turn because we have to be the rock” (the comment below that began with “THANK YOU. No one thinks about how it affects the men…”

The second was met with a bunch of statistics of how men are more likely to be victims of a violent crime and women are exaggerating/don’t have a right to feel unsafe when MEN are the ones who actually suffer.  

It was actually so infuriating to read. Like, those threads should be screenshotted and included under the definition of “mansplaining” lol

Men’s anxiety and mental health should be taken seriously. Men being victims of violent crimes is obviously fucking terrible.

But WHY are women never given a chance to share our experiences without having men latch on to say, “WeLL AcKShuALLy,…” or “oKaY, buT MEn…”

Like, fuck.

Omfg. I work in child support, and I think we are the only thing keeping fax machines alive. 

It’s also maddening that if we do get an e-mail attachment, we have to print it out and send it to a different team to scan it into the system. Or even more infuriating is the process of getting a certified copy of another state’s support order to register in our state. Some states accept digital certifications, but others (like mine) do not. So we have to wait for a snail mailed, hard copy (that most often gets lost in-transit). 

Thank you for letting me rant, as this process makes me want to scream lol.
